name: ServiceAreaRings
job: Explain where a business delivers or travels as concentric radar-style rings from the shop, each ring naming neighbourhoods with its delivery time and fee
visitor_action: hover or tap a ring or neighbourhood to see its time and fee; arrow keys move between rings
mobile: rings fill the width, details open in a card below
motion: rings expand from the centre in a stagger, selected ring tints with a quick fade (reduced-motion: rings static)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Harbour chart: pale sea-foam paper, fine navy contour lines, signal-orange centre pin, cartographic hairlines with soft grain
notes: 2026-11-24: broken-fix pass. Neighbourhood labels now size by their own text (max-content, word wraps only) and are placed from MEASURED boxes (hidden twin layer, re-measured on fonts/text change): the text body must sit inside one ring band, clear of compass, card, frame and other labels; a label that cannot fit falls back to a dot (name on hover/focus). Fixed letter-by-letter stacking at the right edge (labels and ring pills were shrink-to-fit against the room left of their anchor). Centre label capped to 2 lines left of the compass. Checked headless at 1280 / 375 / worst 1280 / worst 375; dense worst-375 dots can still touch on the tiniest rings.
